name: Nitesh Wayafalkar
tagline: I build and automate cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and AI-assisted developer tooling.
about: Lead DevOps Engineer at Allianz Technologies, based in Pune. AWS EKS Kubernetes Expert | GitOps Automation | 11+ Years IT | AWS Certified Professional
I work across Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD and cloud platforms, and experiment with AI agents that generate pipelines.

experience.summary:
Migrated 400+ repositories and 1,200+ Azure pipelines to GitHub Actions with reusable workflows.
Built Azure and AWS infrastructure with Terraform and delivered zero-downtime database migrations.
Led EKS/AKS upgrades and created AI-powered automation to accelerate migrations.

Managed AWS EKS/ECR workloads, persistent storage, and secure service accounts.
○ Applied least-privilege AWS IAM and used DynamoDB for low-latency financial transactions and sessions.
○ Built Packer images and provisioned infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible.
○ Delivered Kubernetes applications through GitHub Actions and ArgoCD GitOps.
○ Integrated OWASP, Trivy, and SonarQube security scans into CI/CD.
○ Secured microservices with Kubernetes Ingress and AWS Load Balancers.
○ Partnered with developers to ship production features and fixes.
○ Used Kibana for log analysis and Grafana for real-time monitoring.

Managed highly available AWS EKS clusters, using Cluster Autoscaler to scale nodes based on real-time workload demands and optimize resource usage.
○ Built and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, streamlining deployments and reducing manual errors.
○ Automated provisioning of AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, and IAM) with Terraform for consistent, scalable environments.
○ Deployed and monitored Kubernetes workloads with Helm, Prometheus, and Grafana to ensure reliability and performance.
○ Improved release speed and uptime by optimizing pipelines and integrating proactive alerts with CloudWatch.
○ Collaborated with development and QA teams to resolve issues, implement security best practices, and maintain production readiness.

Integrated Selenium, RestAssured, and Cucumber test automation frameworks into GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Deployed QA environments on AWS EC2 and used Grafana and Kibana monitoring to investigate issues and identify root causes.
Performed smoke, functional, regression, and end-to-end integration testing using Selenium WebDriver with TypeScript and BDD frameworks.
Created customized XPath expressions and implemented the Page Object Model (POM) to build and maintain automated tests.
